author: /root/scratch22_build_wrapper

tests.profile: one CPU, two GiB per-process address-space limit, 180-second suite timeout; temporary files, mocked producer/build calls and serial disposable Python children with real temporary flocks only; no Docker, sudo, compiler, production preparation/materialization, network or guest

algorithm_reference.policy: Preserve the reviewed root-development-lock lifetime, inherited descriptor, no outer execution timeout and nonreturning quarantine after started execution without positive current retirement. Extend ordinary termination deferral to HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT after independently reproduced S22-LOCK-1; install atomically before ownership, preserving the canonical child signal mask. No scratch21 prepared, derived or consumed request is reused.

actual_producer_contracts.preparation_authority: Consume the existing scratch22.preparation-release.v1 with PASS_PREPARATION_EXECUTION_RELEASE, execution_released=false, exact target/tree/controller and independently reviewed helper/test/ancestor/prerequisite hashes. Revalidate actual cleanup and source producer contracts through the adapter. Preparation controller Git blobs remain checked after the build checkpoint advances HEAD; no historical mutable HEAD observation is required to remain current.
actual_producer_contracts.prepared_artifacts: The actual inherited preparation Journal.finish terminal has phase=complete, returncode=0, exception=null, preparation_only=true, log path and log_sha256. Bind terminal and log bytes/dev/inode/ownership/mode/link count. Do not replace it with the separate PASS_PREPARE_ONLY stdout result or invent an acceptance status.
actual_producer_contracts.canonical_request: Actual adapter.validate_prepared_request invokes candidate BuildOwner.validate without Docker construction. Prepared request canonical bytes, path, device/inode identity and digest are independently supplied; only preparation_only, executable, execution_released and release_required change for the derived request.

candidate_sha, candidate_tree and image_id from the actual prepared artifacts; no defaults from current HEAD or scratch21

derived_request_sha256 for canonical exact prepared object with only four release flags toggled

source_template_contract.container_identity: Actual canonical owner intentionally generates fresh randomized container name and nonce at execution. Release binds exact owner/driver code, actual image ID and request, never a guessed future container name. Wrapper captures the actual owner receipt and retained current terminal container identity in terminal evidence; cleanup remains separately reviewed.
source_template_contract.serialization: Exactly one heavy operation. Root lock precedes validation/census, and passes into the authenticated candidate outer disk wrapper; that wrapper retains existing shared-heavy and operational exclusions. Existing scratch18 exclusion filename is the owner ABI slot and may be reused only after accepted scratch21 cleanup, never by raw unlink.
source_template_contract.retirement: Preserve existing positive-current-retirement receipt conditions. Unknown stdout, exceptions after execution publication/start, start uncertainty, failed stream capture/fsync or failed terminal evidence publication all enter quarantine before any unlock. Quarantine defers HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT and retains its live root lock through evidence/output/wait exceptions. SIGKILL can kill a flock owner; only existing persistent exclusion barriers survive it, and no live-flock persistence through SIGKILL is claimed. No timed unlock or raw Docker removal exists.

regressions: Only four flags change; prepared executable flags, mismatched derived digest and consumed exclusions refuse
Real preparation terminal field contract, source/cleanup validator calls and canonical candidate owner validator call are exercised
Changed inode, terminal failure, occupied execution path and nonempty output refuse
Exact fetched code/release binding and independent payload review pass; same author, implementation ownership, stale source hash, changed review payload and old attempt release refuse
Symlinks, unexplained hardlinks, duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite JSON refuse
Successful execution retains root descriptor through terminal evidence and only then unlocks
Started execution with malformed stdout, stream-read/start/fsync/evidence failure or explicit uncertain retirement quarantines without unlocking
Positive retired failed build preserves failure and safely releases root lock while shared exclusions remain for separate cleanup
Acquisition failure restores installed signal handlers; preflight signal stops publication; signal during publication preserves request and prevents build start
Quarantine evidence failure still waits; failed stderr open closes earlier stdout descriptor; run_checked passes root lock fd and has no outer timeout

Actual disposable child calls execute with a real temporary root flock, encounters uncertain run_checked, fails quarantine evidence and has its first quarantine wait interrupted. Each HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT child remains live and an independent contender remains blocked. A fifth child has actual stdout EPIPE as well and survives all four signals. Only the exact owned test child is SIGKILLed/reaped; its temporary flock then becomes available as expected.

Atomic signal setup blocks four signals while installing deferral handlers, restores caller mask before lock/build, and restores original handlers/mask only after safe lock close; canonical build child does not inherit a widened signal mask

failed_attempts.corrected_run: 20 tests passed in 0.050 seconds; expanded suites subsequently passed 22 in 0.063 seconds and 25 in 0.070 seconds.

independent_review_bounded_correction.original_proof: Independent real-child temporary-flock test reproduced SIGQUIT's default terminating the quarantined scratch22 owner, releasing its live flock without positive retirement. The original 25 mock/disposable tests passed but did not exercise actual termination delivery.

reference_policy.use: Read only; matched four ordinary termination signals and nonreturning quarantine that catches diagnostic/wait exceptions. No cleanup source was changed.

independent_review_bounded_correction.authorization: Dispatcher authorized one coherent root-termination correction in the original three-file allowlist plus exact original source/test retention files. This is the bounded correction for S22-LOCK-1, not a new acceptance attempt or reset of family history.
independent_review_bounded_correction.correction: Add SIGQUIT deferral. Atomically block HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT while installing handlers before any ownership/mutation, restore caller mask before acquiring root lock and spawning the canonical child, and restore original handlers/mask after safe ownership release only. Quarantine evidence failures are swallowed and its indefinite sleep catches BaseException without printing or escaping.
independent_review_bounded_correction.tests: All original 25 tests retained with handler-count expectations extended to four signals; two new tests add atomic-mask ordering and five real child/flock scenarios. 27 tests pass in 0.714 seconds under the original CPU0/2-GiB/180-second profile.
independent_review_bounded_correction.sigkill_limit: No SIGKILL persistence claim: tests deliberately kill/reap only their own temporary child after proving ordinary-signal quarantine retention, then verify its temporary flock is released. Existing persistent runtime exclusion paths, not a dead process flock, protect real crash recovery.
